'''Kallam Anji Reddy''' (10 August 1941 – 15 March 2013) was an [[Indian people|Indian]] entrepreneur in the [[pharmaceutical]] industry, the founder-chairman of [[Dr. Reddy's Laboratories]], which he established in 1984, and chairman of Dr Reddy's Foundation (DRF), the [[corporate social responsibility]] arm of the group, established 1996.<ref>{{cite news |title=Always Reddy with a healthy dose |url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/Always-Reddy-with-a-healthy-dose-/articleshow/3720801.cms |work=[[The Economic Times]] |date=17 November 2008 }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Dr Reddy's prescription of passion |url=http://www.financialexpress.com/news/Dr%20Reddy%92s%20prescription%20of%20passion/176379/ |work=[[The Financial Express (India)|Financial Express]] |date=3 September 2006 }}</ref> He was a member of the Indian Prime Minister's Council on Trade and Industry.<ref>[http://www.ndtv.com/article/india/govt-announces-padma-awards-81520 Govt announces Padma Awards | NDTV.com<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=DRL founder chief Anji Reddy dies |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/business/2013/mar/16/drl-founder-chief-anji-reddy-dies-459045.html |access-date=2023-01-03 |website=The New Indian Express|date=16 March 2013 }}</ref>

== Life ==
Reddy initially attended SKPVV Hindu High School, Vijayawada. After graduating from Annapotanna Zilla Parishath High School Nutakki, Reddy received his first Bachelor of Science degree from [[Andhra-Christian College|A.C. College]] at [[Guntur City|Guntur]] in 1958.<ref>{{cite news | url=http://quote.bloomberg.com/apps/news?pid=20601109&sid=aPXP80nuYooI | archive-url=https://archive.today/20120713062451/http://quote.bloomberg.com/apps/news?pid=20601109&sid=aPXP80nuYooI | url-status=dead | archive-date=13 July 2012 | publisher=Bloomberg | title=Dr. Reddy's Struggles for Homegrown Hit to Escape Rival Clones | date=4 December 2006 }}</ref> He then earned his B.Sc.(Tech) in Pharmaceuticals and Fine Chemicals from the University Department of Chemical Technology of University of Mumbai (now [[Institute of Chemical Technology]], [[Mumbai]]), followed by a PhD in [[chemical engineering]] under [[L. K. Doraiswamy|L.K Doraiswamy]] from the [[National Chemical Laboratory]], [[Pune]] in 1969.<ref name=re>{{cite web |title= Dr Reddy's: From Rs 25 lakh to Rs 5,800 crore|url=http://www.rediff.com/cms/print.jsp?docpath=//money/2007/jun/12bspec.htm |work=[[Rediff.com]]|page=12 June 2007}}</ref>

Reddy died of cancer on 15 March 2013 at the Apollo Hospital in [[Hyderabad]].<ref>[https://www.indiatoday.in/business/corporate/story/dr-reddys-labs-founder-chairman-anji-reddy-passes-away-156259-2013-03-14 Dr. Reddy's Laboratories founder chairman Dr. Kallam Anji Reddy passes away : Corporate, News – ''India Today'']</ref>

== Awarded ==
The [[Government of India]] honoured him with the [[Padma Shri]] in 2001 and later with the [[Padma Bhushan]] in 2011 for his contribution to the Indian pharmaceutical industry.<ref name="Padma Awards">{{cite web |date=2015 |title=Padma Awards |url=http://mha.nic.in/sites/upload_files/mha/files/LST-PDAWD-2013.pdf |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151015193758/http://mha.nic.in/sites/upload_files/mha/files/LST-PDAWD-2013.pdf |archive-date=15 October 2015 |access-date=21 July 2015 |publisher=Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India}}</ref>
